instruction: Enable Windows Sticky Keys as a motor accessibility aid and keep it enabled throughout the task. Open the provided Grades.ods spreadsheet in LibreOffice Calc. Calculate each student's average score, assign each student a letter grade using the grading table in the spreadsheet, and enter the three students with their average scores and letter grades in the completed grade summary area. Sort the students by average score in descending order and save the spreadsheet.
gt_steps: Keep Sticky Keys enabled throughout the task.
Review the three students and their scores in cells A3:D5.
Review the grading table in cells F2:H7.
Assign each student the correct letter grade using the grading table.
Enter the students, average scores, and letter grades in cells A10:C12.
Sort the completed results by average score from highest to lowest.
Verify that Aisha Khan appears first, Ben Carter appears second, and Chloe Nguyen appears third.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags=[int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_DISABLED' }"
